method.promotionRule: A video-derived claim may enter EDGE as a reusable mechanic hypothesis only when the exact claim is corroborated by independent written rules, manufacturer material, regulator/operator material, or reproducible analysis. Video gameplay or creator commentary alone can never authorize execution.
method.crossDeploymentRule: Physical, demo, foreign-operator, or other-wrapper evidence cannot populate a Spanish operator's provider identity, RTP, stake, jackpot state, GHT, persistence scope or execution threshold.
method.bigWinRule: A big-win or jackpot-hit video is outcome evidence only and never proof of positive EV.
